subject: Question about upcoming deadlines
text: Dear Professor, I hope this message finds you well. I am writing as a longtime family friend of a few students in your seminar, and I wanted to ask for clarification about the upcoming deadlines. I understood that the preliminary drafts are due next Monday, while the final panels are due Friday afternoon. Could you confirm whether the final deadline includes printing time or only electronic submission? If there is flexibility for students who are traveling on Friday, it might be helpful to mention that in the syllabus or in a brief class announcement. A short reminder with a checklist of dates could also ease uncertainty for students who balance this course with part-time work. If possible, could you let me know as soon as you can, especially if the schedule has changed recently or if a revised timeline will be posted online? Thank you very much for your time, and I appreciate any guidance you can provide. Warm regards,
